item.title: Shrinkwrap 0.17.1
item.description: A shoot folder full of RAW files no longer sits permanently yellow — RAW and animated files are reported as not handled rather than as something needing attention. Tagged images get a folder of their own, @replace (or @solo) swaps in place instead, output names now carry the size the file actually is, and @ratio16x9 pairs with any size tag. Plus the tag palette on Shift-Command-Y and a Finder toolbar button.
